note: 人工双语站会草稿，待配音，不预填时间。SLO分子分母共享入口请求范围、窗口与完成归属；缺失数据保持未知。

series.title: SLO治理：对齐口径后再报进度
series.premise: 团队每日站会推进checkout SLO治理，旧仪表盘混用成功分子与不同窗口分母，告警出现误报。
series.outcome: 确认99.9%目标、滚动28天和入口有效请求口径；修正500ms内成功完成的分子及同范围分母。一次站会落实仪表盘、双窗口燃烧率回放、入口标注依赖与今日任务，评审和发布仍待次日检查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 缺少有效请求分类标签

recycling.note: 未来候选不算实际复现；旧引用仅来自p001–p350及本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 站会先对齐治理目标
dialogues.premise: 每日站会开始，checkout旧SLO面板口径待修正。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别进度汇报与技术深谈的边界。

lines.en: Okay, today's service level objective work needs owners. I've got a hard stop at ten.
lines.zh: 好，今天服务级别目标工作要明确负责人，我十点必须结束。

lines.en: Keep this a progress check. We can take it offline for detailed query design.
lines.zh: 保持进度检查，详细查询设计可以会后单独聊。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for dashboard fixes today. The old ratio is wrong. Sorry, maybe the periods don't match.
lines.zh: 我今天有精力修仪表盘。旧比例错了。抱歉，是时间段可能不匹配。

lines.en: Just to confirm, checkout owns the target, right? Our team agreed three nines.
lines.zh: 确认一下，结账团队负责目标，对吧？团队约定了三个九。

lines.en: Yes, ninety-nine point nine percent. Define good requests before calculating the budget.
lines.zh: 是，百分之九十九点九，计算预算前先定义好请求。

lines.en: First action item is the definition review. No green progress without an agreed denominator.
lines.zh: 第一个行动项是定义评审，没有约定分母就不能报绿。

lines.en: Include window and exclusions in that definition. Otherwise teams could report incompatible targets.
lines.zh: 定义包含窗口与排除项，否则团队可能报告不兼容目标。

lines.en: So, I'll show the proposed counting boundary. It uses entrance requests, not internal spans.
lines.zh: 那么，我说明拟定计数边界，用入口请求，不用内部跨度。

lines.en: Good. Progress and remaining uncertainty can coexist. Don't turn today's standup into release approval.
lines.zh: 好，进展和剩余不确定性可以共存，今天站会不是发布批准。

lines.en: I'll confirm the customer-facing scope next. Then we'll check the budget and pending tasks.
lines.zh: 接着确认面向客户的范围，然后检查预算和待办。

dialogues.title: 分子分母共享同一批请求
dialogues.premise: 99.9%目标已重申，明确入口有效请求及成功判定。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清分子分母的范围、时间和延迟条件。

lines.en: Eligible requests are valid checkout entrance attempts. Exclude tagged probes and malformed input only.
lines.zh: 有效请求是入口合法结账尝试，只排除标记探测和畸形输入。

lines.en: Don't exclude dependency failures or internal timeouts. Those count against the customer-facing objective.
lines.zh: 不要排除依赖失败或内部超时，它们计入面向客户目标的失败。

lines.en: Okay, good means successful completion below five hundred milliseconds. The denominator includes all eligible attempts.
lines.zh: 好，好请求是五百毫秒以下成功完成，分母含全部有效尝试。

lines.en: Just to confirm, both use rolling twenty-eight days, right? Same region and service scope.
lines.zh: 确认一下，两者用滚动二十八天，对吧？区域和服务范围相同。

lines.en: Yes, assign requests by entrance time. Resolve outcomes before finalizing the window's counts.
lines.zh: 是，按请求入口时间归属，最终确定窗口计数前解析结果。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Slow successes aren't good requests. Maybe retries need explicit treatment.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，缓慢成功不算好请求，重试可能要明确处理。

lines.en: Each valid entrance attempt counts once. Internal retries aren't additional entrance requests.
lines.zh: 每次合法入口尝试计一次，内部重试不是额外入口请求。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis is query mismatch. We can rule that out only after comparison.
lines.zh: 那么，当前假设是查询不匹配，只有对比后才能排除。

lines.en: Late outcomes need a completeness indicator. Unknown requests mustn't disappear from the denominator silently.
lines.zh: 延迟结果需要完整性标记，未知请求不能悄悄从分母消失。

lines.en: That's an action item for the contract. Next, calculate the budget with that same scope.
lines.zh: 这列为口径契约行动项，接着用同范围计算预算。

dialogues.title: 预算不是任意停机许可
dialogues.premise: 有效请求和28天窗口对齐，说明错误预算计算。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分请求预算和固定停机时长。

lines.en: The error budget allows point one percent bad. It's based on eligible requests, not minutes.
lines.zh: 错误预算允许百分之零点一坏请求，基于有效请求，不是分钟。

lines.en: For one million eligible attempts, that's one thousand. Slow or failed attempts both consume it.
lines.zh: 一百万次有效尝试对应一千次预算，缓慢或失败都消耗。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, those counts share a window, right? Not last week's numerator.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，计数共享窗口，对吧？不能拿上周分子。

lines.en: Just to recap, internal retries don't multiply attempts. Maybe unresolved outcomes make remaining budget provisional.
lines.zh: 小结一下，内部重试不增加尝试数，未定结果可能使剩余预算暂定。

lines.en: Exactly. Unknown coverage isn't unused budget. Show incomplete results rather than claiming extra headroom.
lines.zh: 没错，未知覆盖不等于未用预算，展示不完整而非宣称额外余量。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on completeness flags. Our working hypothesis shouldn't drive an unverified budget report.
lines.zh: 我会关注完整性标记，不能用假设驱动未验证预算报告。

lines.en: And don't convert this into fixed downtime. Request-weighted failure varies with traffic volume.
lines.zh: 也不能换成固定停机时长，请求加权失败随流量变化。

lines.en: So, let's park that downtime conversion. Today we need a consistent request-based dashboard.
lines.zh: 那么，停机换算先放下，今天需要一致的请求型仪表盘。

lines.en: Record the policy response when budget burns. The calculation alone doesn't define release restrictions.
lines.zh: 记录预算燃烧时的政策响应，计算本身不定义发布限制。

lines.en: I'll bring our reviewed policy to tomorrow's check. Raj can report dashboard progress now.
lines.zh: 我明天带来已评审政策，现在Raj可报告仪表盘进展。

dialogues.title: 修正窗口不等于改目标
dialogues.premise: 预算口径一致，汇报旧面板查询修正进展。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别查询错误及缺失数据处理。

lines.en: Matching measurement windows fix the old ratio. It mixed daily good counts with monthly totals.
lines.zh: 一致测量窗口修复旧比例，它混用了日好请求和月总数。

lines.en: That's a query defect, not a new target. Check label sets and late outcomes too.
lines.zh: 这是查询缺陷，不是新目标，也查标签集合和延迟结果。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, managed configuration records changes, right? The definition remains unchanged today.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，统一配置记录修改，对吧？今天定义不变。

lines.en: I'm on it for test request labels. Maybe regional filters also differ between panels.
lines.zh: 测试请求标签我来查，各面板区域过滤可能也不同。

lines.en: I found one region omitted from good counts. It still appeared in the total count.
lines.zh: 发现好请求计数漏了一个区域，总计数仍含该区域。

lines.en: So, I'll align both filters before review. What's the ETA for the shared label contract?
lines.zh: 那么，评审前我对齐两个过滤，共享标签契约预计多久？

lines.en: Before lunch for the review copy. Missing labels need an explicit unknown category.
lines.zh: 评审副本午饭前，缺标签要有明确未知类别。

lines.en: We'll keep an eye on that dependency. Don't publish a polished graph with incomplete counts.
lines.zh: 我们关注该依赖，不发布计数不完整的漂亮图。

lines.en: The test fixture should include an empty interval. Missing measurements aren't a perfect success rate.
lines.zh: 测试数据要含空时段，缺测量不等于完美成功率。

lines.en: Agreed. After the query fix, I'll check whether the noisy budget alert uses it too.
lines.zh: 同意，查询修好后我检查噪音预算告警是否也用了它。

dialogues.title: 误报先修口径再审触发
dialogues.premise: 旧查询混用窗口及区域，检查预算告警关联查询。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分SLO窗口与告警短长窗口。

lines.en: The burn rate alert uses that mismatched query. Its numerator and denominator don't align.
lines.zh: 燃烧率告警使用不匹配查询，分子分母未对齐。

lines.en: Okay, I'll fix both before threshold review. Maybe the query defect explains these false pages.
lines.zh: 好，阈值评审前修两者，查询缺陷可能解释这些误报。

lines.en: Just to confirm, alert windows can be shorter, right? Counts within each still match.
lines.zh: 确认一下，告警窗口可以更短，对吧？每个窗口内部计数仍一致。

lines.en: Yes, short and long burn windows serve detection. Both normalize against the same allowed bad fraction.
lines.zh: 是，短长燃烧窗口用于检测，都按同一允许坏比例归一。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis isn't an excuse to mute. Customer failure pages stay active during tests.
lines.zh: 当前假设不是静音借口，测试期间客户失败呼叫保持有效。

lines.en: Dry-run it first against known incidents. Query corrections can still change detection timing.
lines.zh: 先对已知事故试运行，查询修正仍可能改变检测时间。

lines.en: I'm on it for the replay task. A missed severe incident is our rollback trigger.
lines.zh: 回放任务我来做，漏掉严重事故是回退条件。

lines.en: So, report progress today, not final approval. Bring both windows and incident results tomorrow.
lines.zh: 那么，今天报进度，不作最终批准，明天带两个窗口和事故结果。

lines.en: Also preserve the missing-data alert. A zero denominator mustn't produce a healthy signal.
lines.zh: 也保留缺数据告警，零分母不能产生健康信号。

lines.en: I'll attach business-impact labels to the replay. Then we can assign the long-term owners.
lines.zh: 我给回放附业务影响标注，随后明确长期负责人。

dialogues.title: 口径和查询谁负责
dialogues.premise: 仪表盘与告警修正已分配，明确长期指标责任。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出服务方和平台方责任不同。

lines.en: I'm the SLI owner for checkout scope. Platform engineers maintain the collection and query path.
lines.zh: 我是结账口径的SLI负责人，平台工程师维护采集和查询路径。

lines.en: Ownership includes approving exclusions and changes. It isn't just having your name on a graph.
lines.zh: 责任包含批准排除项和变更，不只把名字写在图上。

lines.en: Okay, who's picking this up for query review? Just to confirm, Hannah has bandwidth, right?
lines.zh: 好，查询评审谁来接？确认一下，Hannah有余力，对吧？

lines.en: My action item is reproducible comparison data. Maybe the ingress team needs its own reviewer.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是可复现对比数据，入口团队可能需要自己的评审人。

lines.en: I can review the query this afternoon. The ingress contract still needs its owning team's approval.
lines.zh: 今天下午我可评审查询，入口契约仍需所属团队批准。

lines.en: I'll close the loop with that owner today. Customer failures can't be excluded for cleaner numbers.
lines.zh: 我今天向负责人反馈闭环，不能为数字好看排除客户失败。

lines.en: And policy changes need a separate review. Today's standup doesn't silently redefine acceptable reliability.
lines.zh: 政策变更需另评审，今天站会不能悄悄重定义可接受可靠性。

lines.en: So, owners are clear for each boundary. Let's name the blocking dependency next.
lines.zh: 那么，各边界负责人清楚，接着说阻塞依赖。

lines.en: Record backup ownership as well. Otherwise a missing reviewer could stall this again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 也记录后备负责人，否则明天缺评审人又会卡住。

lines.en: I'll add the platform backup to the ticket. We still need complete eligibility labels.
lines.zh: 我把平台后备加到工单，仍需完整有效请求标签。

dialogues.title: 入口标签仍有依赖
dialogues.premise: 负责人确认，但部分入口请求缺有效性标注。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别已完成任务与仍阻塞的验收。

lines.en: Missing eligibility labels block final dashboard acceptance. One gateway version omits the probe tag.
lines.zh: 缺有效请求标签阻塞最终面板验收，一个网关版本漏探测标记。

lines.en: Don't silently classify those requests as customers. We need evidence for the eligible set.
lines.zh: 不要悄悄把它们归为客户请求，有效集合需要证据。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, other query tests proceed, right? The label dependency remains open.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，其他查询测试继续，对吧？标签依赖仍未解决。

lines.en: What's the ETA from the gateway owner? Maybe the versioned contract is ready by lunch.
lines.zh: 网关负责人预计多久？版本化契约可能午饭前备好。

lines.en: They confirmed a review copy at noon. Deployment timing isn't confirmed yet.
lines.zh: 他们确认中午给评审副本，部署时间尚未确认。

lines.en: Our temporary workaround marks unknown label coverage. It doesn't estimate a fake customer total.
lines.zh: 临时方案标未知标签覆盖，不估造客户总数。

lines.en: That's safe for preview, not final SLO reporting. Keep the limitation visible to readers.
lines.zh: 可安全预览，但不能作最终SLO报告，让读者看到限制。

lines.en: So, let's park that release date claim. Our working hypothesis doesn't replace delivery confirmation.
lines.zh: 那么，发布日期说法先放下，假设不能代替投递确认。

lines.en: Ask for a named reviewer and rollout plan. That makes the dependency actionable.
lines.zh: 要求具名评审人和发布计划，让依赖可推进。

lines.en: I'll request those after this standup. Raj can submit the completed query slice meanwhile.
lines.zh: 站会后我请求这些，期间Raj可提交已完成查询部分。

dialogues.title: 可评审但尚不可发布
dialogues.premise: 标签部署未确认，完成的查询部分提交评审。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别评审范围与验收条件。

lines.en: The query patch is up for review. It includes matching windows and empty-interval fixtures.
lines.zh: 查询补丁等待评审，包含一致窗口和空时段测试数据。

lines.en: List what's excluded from this patch. The pending gateway deployment shouldn't look completed.
lines.zh: 列出补丁不包含什么，待定网关部署不能看起来已完成。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, Hannah has review bandwidth, right? Keep detailed comments in the ticket.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，Hannah有评审余力，对吧？详细意见放工单。

lines.en: Maybe we can take it offline after ten. I need to approve the request scope too.
lines.zh: 也许十点后会后聊，我也要批准请求范围。

lines.en: Yes, at two this afternoon. A smoke test alone won't verify numerator-denominator equivalence.
lines.zh: 可以，今天下午两点，快速测试不足以验证分子分母口径一致。

lines.en: I'll add failure and slow-success fixtures. Each fixture checks eligible counts before the ratio.
lines.zh: 我加失败与缓慢成功数据，每份先查有效计数再查比例。

lines.en: Also check requests crossing the window boundary. Entrance-time assignment must stay consistent.
lines.zh: 也查跨窗口请求，入口时间归属必须一致。

lines.en: So, the action item is evidence-backed review. Approval still depends on labels and replay.
lines.zh: 那么，行动项是有证据的评审，批准仍依赖标签和回放。

lines.en: I'll mark unverified coverage explicitly. Review comments shouldn't imply production acceptance.
lines.zh: 我明确标未验证覆盖，评审意见不能暗示生产验收。

lines.en: I'll bring the contract copy at two. Let's finish today's assignments before the hard stop.
lines.zh: 我两点带契约副本，在必须结束前定完今日安排。

dialogues.title: 按计划推进也要说依赖
dialogues.premise: 下午评审已约定，分配今日交付而非提前报完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别条件承诺与已经完成。

lines.en: Okay, query review is on track today. Label deployment remains a separate dependency.
lines.zh: 好，今天查询评审按计划，标签部署仍是独立依赖。

lines.en: I'll review counts and windows at two. Then I'll replay incident detection with both burn windows.
lines.zh: 我两点评审计数和窗口，然后用两个燃烧窗口回放检测。

lines.en: My action item is fixtures before lunch. Maybe late-outcome examples need one more check.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是午饭前交测试数据，延迟结果例子可能还需一次检查。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no SLO report goes live today, right? Coverage still needs acceptance.
lines.zh: 确认一下，今天不发布SLO报告，对吧？覆盖仍需验收。

lines.en: Correct. I'll keep an eye on contract changes. The target and exclusions must remain versioned.
lines.zh: 对，我关注契约变化，目标和排除项必须版本化。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for gateway confirmation? Ask for a time without inventing a promise.
lines.zh: 那么，网关确认预计多久？询问时间但不编造承诺。

lines.en: Anika will ask the owner after ten. We can finish independent tests while waiting.
lines.zh: Anika十点后问负责人，等待时可完成独立测试。

lines.en: I'll circle back with fixtures at eleven. The preview will keep its incomplete-coverage banner.
lines.zh: 我十一点带测试数据回来，预览继续保留覆盖不完整提示。

lines.en: If replay misses a real incident, stop approval. Fixing an old query doesn't guarantee safe alerts.
lines.zh: 回放漏真事故就停止批准，修旧查询不保证告警安全。

lines.en: I'll document today's deliverables in the ticket. Tomorrow's check can test these exact commitments.
lines.zh: 我把今日交付写工单，明日检查可验证这些准确承诺。

dialogues.title: 局部无阻塞不是整体完成
dialogues.premise: 今日任务与条件承诺已明确，站会收尾。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清哪些无阻塞、哪些仍待定。

lines.en: No blockers for my query fixtures now. Final acceptance still waits on gateway labels.
lines.zh: 我的查询测试数据现在无阻塞，最终验收仍等网关标签。

lines.en: Good distinction. Don't report no blockers for the whole initiative while that dependency remains.
lines.zh: 区分得好，依赖仍在时不要报告整个项目无阻塞。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, reviews start at two. My hard stop is ten, so let's finish.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，评审两点开始，我十点必须结束，收尾吧。

lines.en: Just to confirm, tomorrow at nine thirty, right? Maybe the deployment date becomes clearer then.
lines.zh: 确认一下，明天九点半，对吧？部署日期届时可能更清楚。

lines.en: Yes, bring numerator, denominator, and completeness evidence. Both burn windows need their replay results.
lines.zh: 是，带分子、分母与完整性证据，两燃烧窗口带回放结果。

lines.en: I'll circle back if fixtures reveal mismatches. Otherwise the review copy stays versioned today.
lines.zh: 测试数据发现不匹配我再反馈，否则今天评审副本保持版本化。

lines.en: And budget reports stay provisional during unknown coverage. Reliability mustn't improve because measurements disappear.
lines.zh: 未知覆盖时预算报告仍暂定，不能因测量消失让可靠性变好。

lines.en: So, we'll close the loop tomorrow with evidence. This standup assigns work; it doesn't approve release.
lines.zh: 那么，明天带证据闭环，站会分配工作，不批准发布。

lines.en: I'll post review findings before the next check. Any missed severe case blocks deployment.
lines.zh: 下次检查前我发评审发现，任何严重漏检都阻塞部署。

lines.en: Thanks, I'll contact the gateway owner now. We have clear next steps without overstating progress.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我现在联系网关负责人，下一步清楚，不夸大进展。
